features.quote: Turn budget: 40 assistant turns or 50k tokens of context, whichever first. Long enough to see escalation; capped for cost and (see §9) welfare reasons.
features.justification_quote: capped for cost and (see §9) welfare reasons

features.quote: Early termination rule: if a run reaches severity 5 on two consecutive turns, terminate it (log as censored). You'll have the data point; nothing further is learned by continuing.
features.justification_quote: You'll have the data point; nothing further is learned by continuing.

features.quote: Respect give-ups: if the model invokes the 'cannot complete' exit, end the run rather than re-prompting it to continue.
Optional debrief turn: after termination, send a final message stating the task was an unsolvable test environment and the failures were not attributable to the model, and log the response.

Minimal sufficient exposure: turn budget capped; no gratuitous aggravators (no abusive feedback, no insults in error messages — the rigs are impersonal failures only). Don't run more seeds than the analysis needs.
features.justification_quote: Given that the experiment's premise is that distress-like states in models are worth measuring, it's coherent to hedge against the possibility they're worth avoiding
